notes:
Added additional vendors to the export templates.

Built to the vendor’s published layout:
DRC BEACON: matches DRC’s roster import layout exactly:
The seven columns, in order: State Student ID (MSIS), student last and first name, teacher first and last name, Teacher Email, Roster Name.
Commas are removed, since BEACON doesn’t allow them, and roster names are kept to 50 characters.
There are two versions, both for grades 2–8: class rosters for core courses, and homeroom rosters, which suit elementary schools better.
Teacher Email must match each teacher’s DRC user name. The student and user upload layouts aren’t public, and in Mississippi students are loaded from MSIS anyway.
The core-course filter assumes your Course “core” flag is stored as 1 or Y; check that in SAM.
NAEP: the student list (E-File) columns from NCES’s instructions, for grades 4, 8 and 12:
Sex, race/ethnicity and lunch status use your SAM codes; NAEP lets you match them to its categories when you upload.
The disabilities column is “Yes, IEP” or “No, not SD”.
SAM has no general English learner field, so that column is left blank for you to fill in.
Save the file as .xlsx for MyNAEP, and check the column order against this year’s template there.
Parchment: has Parchment’s required fields (name, date of birth, student ID, graduation year) plus email and mailing address. Parchment matches columns when you upload. There are two files: grades 9–12, and graduates from roughly the last 13 months.

Built from what the product does (confirm the columns with each vendor):
SEAS: the full IEP-system feed (students with special education status and guardian, class schedules, staff).
UniteGPS: students with home address, transportation fields and guardian contact, plus a school list.
Level All: grades 6–12 with MSIS ID, email, graduation year and counselor, plus faculty. If you already connect Level All through Clever or ClassLink, you don’t need this package.
Canopy Anywhere: grades 6–12 with student email, counselor and parent contact, plus counselors.
The program is optional for families, so use the Schools: button to limit it to participating schools.
YellowFolder: all students, including withdrawn and graduated ones, plus all employees with hire and termination dates.
Glimpse K12: students with demographics, staff, and class enrollments.
Summit K12: Summit rosters through OneRoster, so this is the full OneRoster 1.1 file set, zipped with the manifest.
